agyos_skill.intent: Interact with the Camber data science and agentic platform via its MCP server. Create, discover, and chat with Camber agents; manage team and personal workspaces; and orchestrate multi-agent data workflows.
agyos_skill.instructions: Interact with the [Camber](https://cambercloud.com) agentic data science platform through its hosted MCP server (`camber-mcp`). Camber lets you build, deploy, and compose AI agents that share data, collaborate on tasks, and integrate with your existing toolchain. **Endpoint:** `https://camber-mcp.cambercloud.com/mcp` **Auth:** OAuth (browser-based, no manual API key required). On first use the client will open an OAuth flow mapped to your Camber account. | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | `usage_guide` | Onboarding instructions for the active session | | `user_info` | Authenticated user profile and team associations | | `teams_list` | List personal and team workspaces | | `teams_select` | Switch the active workspace (`team_name` or `personal=true`) | | `agents_list` | List agents filtered by scope (`personal` / `team` / `all`) | | `agents_create` | Create a new agent in the active workspace | | `agents_chat` | Chat with an agent via its `@owner.alias` tag | 1. **Confirm scope** — verify the task involves Camber agent management, workspace selection, or agent-to-agent orchestration. 2. **Check session** — call `user_info` to confirm the OAuth session is active. If not, follow the OAuth prompt before proceeding. 3. **Select workspace** — call `teams_list` to discover available workspaces, then `teams_select` to activate the correct one. 4. **Discover agents** — call `agents_list` with the appropriate scope to find existing agents before creating new ones. 5. **Execute the task**: - To chat with an existing agent: call `agents_chat` with the full `@owner.alias` tag and your message. - To create an agent: call `agents_create` with `name`, `alias`, and optionally `description` and `system_prompt`. 6. **Report results** — summarise what workspace is active, which agents were involved, and the agent's response or the created agent's details. ```text agents_list scope="all" agents_chat agent_tag="@alice.researcher" message="Summarise last quarter's sales data" ``` ```text
